description: The numeral 0 as a tall narrow oval beside a percent sign. The percent sign is a long diagonal stroke rising to the right with a small solid dot at its upper left and lower right.
Two stacked lines of rounded bold text: the numeral 10 centred above the letters AQI. The A has a small triangular counter and the Q a short tail at its lower right.
The heavy rounded text 100% in one horizontal line. Two narrow oval zeros sit between a plain numeral 1 and a compact percent sign with small solid circles.
Two stacked lines of rounded text: a single numeral 1 with a short flag centred above the word DAY. The letters are evenly spaced and the D, A and Y share one baseline.
The heavy rounded text 2 WAY in one horizontal line. A numeral 2 is followed by a gap and the word WAY, its W made of pointed strokes.
The bold rounded text 30% in one horizontal line. A numeral 3 with two open bowls and an oval 0 are followed by a smaller percent sign with dots at either end of a diagonal stroke.
Two stacked lines of heavy rounded text: the numeral 30 centred above the word DAYS. The letters are thick and closely spaced, with small closed counters.
The text 4:3 in one horizontal line: an open-topped numeral 4, a colon of two solid dots, and a numeral 3 with a flat top stroke.
Two stacked lines of bold rounded text: the numeral 404 above three letter Xs. The Xs are evenly spaced with long crossing diagonal strokes.
The numeral 45 in one horizontal line of large rounded text. The 4 is open-topped with a long vertical stem, and the 5 has a flat top stroke over a round lower bowl.
The bold rounded text 50% in one horizontal line. A flat-topped numeral 5 and an oval 0 are followed by a percent sign with a diagonal stroke between two dots.
Two stacked lines of very heavy rounded text: the numeral 500 above the word ERROR. The letters are thick and close enough that their counters are small slits.
The heavy rounded text 7 DAYS in one horizontal line. A numeral 7 is followed by a gap and the word DAYS, with small closed counters in the D and A.
The bold rounded text 70% in one horizontal line. A numeral 7 with a straight diagonal stem and an oval 0 are followed by a percent sign with a diagonal stroke between two dots.
The rounded text 70s in one horizontal line: a numeral 7 with a straight diagonal stem, a tall oval 0, and a smaller lowercase s sitting on the baseline.
Two stacked lines of heavy rounded text: a single numeral 7 centred above the word DAYS. The letters are thick with small closed counters in the D and A.
The rounded text 80s in one horizontal line: a numeral 8 of two stacked round bowls, a tall oval 0, and a smaller lowercase s sitting on the baseline.
The heavy rounded text 9:40 in one horizontal line, like a digital clock reading. A small colon of two short dots separates the numeral 9 from 40.
The rounded text 90s in one horizontal line: a numeral 9 with a round bowl and curved tail, a tall oval 0, and a smaller lowercase s sitting on the baseline.
A tall capital A with a pointed apex and horizontal crossbar beside a lowercase i. The i is a plain vertical stem with a short separate dot above it.
A capital A with a pointed apex and horizontal crossbar beside a lowercase n with a single rounded arch. Both letters share a baseline and simple even strokes.
The capital letters CSS in one horizontal line of even rounded strokes. An open C is followed by two matching S shapes with squared, rounded curves.
The bold rounded capitals FAQ in one horizontal line. The A has a small triangular counter and the round Q has a short curved tail sweeping out at its lower right.
Two tall capitals, G and O, side by side in even rounded strokes. The G has a short inward horizontal bar, and the O is a tall stadium shape.
The capitals HDR in one horizontal line of even rounded strokes. An H with a middle crossbar is followed by a rounded D and an R with a straight diagonal leg.
The heavy rounded capitals NEW in one horizontal line. The N and E are compact and the W is formed of thick stroke peaks with narrow gaps.
The capitals UHD in one horizontal line of even rounded strokes. A rounded U, an H with a middle crossbar, and a D with a round right side.
Three identical heavy rounded capital Ws side by side. Their thick strokes nearly touch, leaving narrow slits between the peaks.
A jet ski seen from the side, rising to the right: a long seat line and sloped body lead up to a handlebar stem bent back at the top. A wavy water line runs beneath the hull.

A head-and-shoulders person outline on the left, with a small hollow rectangle and a short horizontal line stacked to its right like profile details. The round head sits directly on the arched shoulders.

Three long pointed loops radiate from a small central triangle: one upward, one to the lower left and one to the right. Each loop is a narrow teardrop with a slim open centre, forming a twisting ribbon.
An outlined airliner seen from above, flying diagonally toward the upper right. A long rounded fuselage carries two wide swept wings at its middle and two small tail fins at the lower left.
A capital A with a pointed apex beside a lowercase m with two rounded arches. A long horizontal line spans the full width beneath both letters.
A head-and-shoulders bust with a tall rounded-square head resting on a wide shoulder arc. The face has two slanted eyebrows angled down toward the centre and a downturned frowning mouth.
A capital A with a pointed apex beside a lowercase r with a short curved shoulder. A long horizontal line spans the full width beneath both letters.
A nearly complete circle drawn as one stroke, open at the upper right. A right-angled arrowhead sits at the upper-right end, pointing clockwise, while the other end stops just below it.
A wide downward-pointing chevron drawn as a closed outline. Two parallel V lines join at flat vertical ends on either side, forming a thick hollow arrow shape.
A left-pointing arrow with an open two-stroke head. Its straight shaft bends into a downward curve on the right, ending at the lower right.
An anticlockwise arc wraps around the right side of the numeral 45, open on the left. An arrowhead at the top points left, and the arc tail ends beneath the numerals.
An arrow rises from the lower left, curves over at the top and points right with an open two-stroke head. Its lower stem slants diagonally toward the lower right.
Two separate arrows on one diagonal axis, one pointing to the upper right and one to the lower left. Each has a right-angled head, and their shafts overlap side by side in the middle.
A single long horizontal shaft with an open two-stroke arrowhead at each end, pointing left and right.
Four short diagonal arrows arranged in the corners of a square, each pointing inward toward the centre. Each arrow ends in a right-angled head near the middle.
Two curved arrows form a broken circle, both turning clockwise. One head sits at the upper right and the other at the lower left, with small gaps between the arcs.

Three elongated elliptical orbits cross at equal angles around a small hexagonal nucleus with a central dot. One orbit stands vertical and two tilt diagonally, forming a symmetrical six-pointed outline.

A link drawn on a diagonal from lower left to upper right: two rounded U-shaped ends open toward each other. Their parallel straight strokes run past each other through the middle with a short separate bar between them.
The heavy rounded capitals AUTO in one horizontal line. The A has a tiny counter, the U is round-bottomed, the T has a wide top bar and the O is a tall stadium.
A scalloped flower-shaped rosette with eight rounded lobes surrounds a central ring. Two ribbon tails hang beneath it, joined at a centre notch and ending in outer points.
A tall capital B with a straight stem and two rounded bowls, the lower bowl slightly wider. A short horizontal line sits centred beneath the letter.
A capital B with two rounded bowls beside a lowercase a with a round bowl and a short straight stem. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A classical bank facade: a wide triangular pediment roof over three evenly spaced vertical columns. The columns stand on a long horizontal base line, detached from the roof.
Three vertical line bars of different heights stand on a long horizontal baseline. The middle bar is tallest, the left bar medium, and the right bar shortest.
Three hollow rectangular bars rise in height from left to right, standing on a shared horizontal baseline that extends past both sides.
A trapezoidal basket wider at the top, with a flat rim and rounded lower corners. A tall narrow triangular handle rises from the rim with a rounded apex.
A tall straight-sided mug with rounded bottom corners and a squared loop handle on its right. A bumpy cloud of foam overflows the rim at the top.
A bell with a rounded dome, sides flaring outward to a wide curved lip. A short stem rises from the top, and a small semicircular clapper hangs beneath the lip.
A capital B with two rounded bowls beside a lowercase i with a plain stem and short dot. A horizontal line sits beneath both letters.
A round bomb at the lower left with a short neck and a straight fuse rising diagonally to the upper right. A jagged spiky spark burst sits at the fuse tip.

A side-view ankle boot facing right: a tall straight shaft with a wide rim at the top, curving at the instep into a long rounded toe. Two short lace hooks project from the front of the shaft, and a low heel step marks the sole.

A bumpy cloud-like broccoli head on a forked stem at the upper left, overlapped by a diagonal carrot at the lower right. The carrot tapers to a rounded point with two crossing leaf strokes at its top.
A front-facing cow head: a tall tapering rounded-rectangle face with two pointed ears angling outward from its sides. Two short curved horns rise from the upper corners.
A large open capital C followed by two small equal plus signs sitting side by side at its mid-height.
A check mark and an X mark side by side on one line, the check on the left and the X on the right. Both use equal-weight straight strokes and similar heights.
A front-view car with a rectangular body, a trapezoid windscreen cabin on top and two short wheel stubs. Two wavy S-shaped skid tracks trail beneath the wheels.
A wide rounded-rectangle case with a small rounded handle loop centred on its top edge. The body is otherwise plain.
A landscape rounded-rectangle banknote with a large ring in its centre. Two small oval marks sit at the left and right, level with the ring.
A tall C-shaped curve open to the right with one horizontal bar crossing its middle and extending left past the curve.
A rounded-rectangle speech bubble with a pointed tail descending from its lower left. Two horizontal text lines of unequal length sit inside, the lower one shorter.
The Chinese character wen: a short vertical tick above a long horizontal bar, with two curved strokes crossing in an X beneath it that sweep out to the lower left and lower right.
Two curved arrows form a broken circle, turning clockwise. The upper arc ends in an open chevron head pointing right at the top, and the lower arc ends in one pointing left at the bottom.
A landscape rounded-rectangle clapperboard with a narrow top band split by one diagonal stripe. A single horizontal line runs across the middle of the lower board.
A stick figure running to the right, leaning forward with a round head. One arm reaches forward and one back; the rear leg kicks out behind while the front leg bends down to the ground.
An upright rounded-rectangle clipboard board with a rounded clip on its top edge. The clip has a small inner opening and the board is otherwise empty.
A large circle with four small dots arranged in a diamond around its centre. A straight film tail leaves the bottom of the circle and runs horizontally to the right.
A circular clock face with four short tick marks at twelve, three, six and nine. A long hand points straight up and a shorter hand angles down toward the lower left, reading about seven o’clock.
A tall open capital C beside a lowercase n with a single rounded arch. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A wide cup with a flat rim, straight sides and a rounded bottom, with a rounded loop handle on the right. Two wavy steam lines rise above the rim.
A tall C-shaped curve open to the right, crossed by one long diagonal stroke rising from the lower left to the upper right through its middle.
A comb tilted slightly clockwise: a long straight spine along the right with a short foot at each end. Three short parallel teeth project from the spine to the left.
A theatre mask with a straight top edge curving slightly and a rounded shield-like chin. Two upturned arched eyes and a wide smiling mouth sit inside, and a small ring sits at the upper-right corner.
A rounded-rectangle speech bubble with a pointed tail descending from its lower right. Two horizontal text lines sit inside, the lower one shorter.
Two head-and-shoulders busts side by side, each a round head above a shoulder arc. The right head has a centre-parted hair line across its top, distinguishing it from the plain left head.
A wide crescent-shaped croissant spans the lower half, divided into segments by two slanted lines. A small coffee cup with a loop handle sits centred above it.
An upright elongated hexagonal crystal with pointed top and bottom. Internal edges show a diamond facet at each end joined by two vertical side faces, giving a three-dimensional prism.

A cyclist riding to the right: two round wheels at the bottom, a round head at the upper right, and an angular body leaning forward with one arm reaching to the handlebar and a leg dropping between the wheels.
A capital D with a rounded bowl beside a lowercase b with a tall stem and round bowl. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A tall rounded face outline with a smiling curved mouth. A vertical line drops from the top to above the mouth and a horizontal line crosses the upper half, dividing the forehead into four sections.
Three small ring nodes linked by two straight lines forming a left-pointing angle. The middle node sits at the left vertex, with one node at the upper right and one at the lower right.
A large circle with a single straight hand running from a rounded pivot at its centre toward the upper right.
A circle split top to bottom by a straight vertical line. A small downward-curving arch crosses the vertical line in the lower part of the circle.

An abstract single-stroke dog head facing left: a tall pointed ear at the top, a rounded snout bulging out to the left, and a short neck line dropping below. A long diagonal line runs from the ear tip down to the lower right as the back of the neck.
A dollar sign centred at the top above two long parallel horizontal lines of equal length. The S curve has a short vertical stroke through its top and bottom.
A solid round dot on the baseline followed by the heavy rounded capitals COM. The C is open, the O a tall stadium and the M a pair of rounded peaks.
Two identical paddles stand upright side by side, each an oval head on a short straight handle pointing down.
A capital D with a rounded bowl beside a smaller lowercase s. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
Two stacked lines of heavy rounded capitals: DUTY above FREE, each filling the full width. The letters are thick with narrow counters.
A circle divided by a vertical spoke and two diagonal spokes crossing at its centre, making six evenly spaced spokes that reach the rim.
A light bulb with a round glass narrowing into a short rounded base. Two concentric signal arcs float in the upper glass like a wireless symbol.
A tall rectangular building on a long ground line, with two short horizontal window marks stacked in its middle. A lower annex with a sloping roof attaches to its right side.
A simple house outline: a pointed gable roof with short eaves extending past both walls, over straight vertical walls and a flat base with rounded corners. The interior is empty.
A house outline with a pointed gable roof and short eaves over straight walls and a flat base. A narrow straight chimney rises from the right slope of the roof.
A capital E with three horizontal arms beside a smaller lowercase s. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A head-and-shoulders person outline: a round head floating above a wide semicircular shoulder arc, with a small gap between them.
A tall vertical stroke with rounded ends above a small separate dot, forming a narrow exclamation mark.
An almond-shaped eye outline with pointed corners at left and right. A round iris ring sits at its centre, touching neither lid.
A circular face with two short horizontal lines for relaxed closed eyes and a wide U-shaped smile beneath them.
A fish facing left with a round eye, its tail formed by crossing lines at the right. A vertical fishing line with a break drops at the left into a J-shaped hook curving up beside the fish.
A horizontal kitchen knife lies above a fish. The knife has a long straight handle to the right and a tapering blade to the left; the fish faces right with a triangular tail at the left.
A fish facing right: a pointed lens-shaped body with a triangular forked tail at the left. A small curved gill arc sits near the head.
An arrow bends in a tall half-loop on the right, running from a short stroke at the bottom up around to a straight top shaft. An open arrowhead at the upper left points left.
A plant with a straight stem and two pointed leaves spreading from its base. A round coin bearing a dollar sign forms the flower head at the top of the stem.
An almond-shaped eye outline with pointed corners at left and right. A round iris ring sits at its centre, touching neither lid.
A circle with four short straight ticks crossing its rim at top, bottom, left and right, each extending both inside and outside the ring. The centre is open.
A curved arrow rising from the lower left, bending to the right at the top. It ends in two stacked open chevron heads pointing right.
Four straight arrows point toward a shared centre from the top, bottom, left and right. Their open V-shaped heads stop just short of meeting, leaving a small empty centre.
Four identical upward arrows arranged in a two-by-two grid. Each has a straight vertical shaft and an open V-shaped head.
The heavy rounded capitals FREE in one horizontal line. The F, R and two Es are thick and closely spaced, with the R having a small closed bowl.
A wide building outline with a shallow pitched roof and straight walls. A large rectangular door opening fills the front, crossed by one horizontal line near its top.
A tall rounded-rectangle fuel pump body with a short horizontal display slot near its top. A hose leaves the lower right side, rises in a curve and bends outward at the top.
A partial arc like the top of a dial, open at the lower right, with a teardrop-shaped needle pointing up to the right from below its centre. Three short rays radiate above the arc.
An open hand lies horizontally at the bottom, palm up, with the thumb line across it and fingers extending to the right. A small house outline with a pointed roof floats above the palm.
An open hand lies horizontally at the bottom, palm up, with fingers curling to the right. A house outline with a pointed roof and short eaves floats centred above it.
A circle with a central horizontal equator line and two curved meridians forming a tall lens shape through the middle, meeting at the top and bottom of the rim.
A round golf ball with two small dimple marks sits on top of a T-shaped tee: a short horizontal bar with a long vertical peg beneath.
A mortarboard shown in three-quarter view: a flat diamond-shaped top board over a rounded skull cap with straight sides and a V-shaped lower edge.
A head-and-shoulders person wearing a mortarboard. A diamond cap top sits over a band across the forehead, the face is an open rounded shape, and wide rounded-rectangle shoulders sit beneath.
Two perpendicular axes form an L at the left and bottom. A zigzag line rises from the lower left to a peak, dips, then climbs steeply to the upper right.
Four equal rounded squares arranged in a two-by-two grid with even gaps between them.
A head-and-shoulders person outline: a round head resting on flat shoulders with rounded corners and straight sides dropping down.
A flat hand seen from the side, palm down, reaching from the left with the thumb folded beneath. Two wavy vertical heat lines rise beneath the palm.
Two hands clasp in the centre of a horizontal composition, one gripping over the other. Each arm ends in a short vertical cuff bar at the far left and far right.
A capital H with a middle crossbar beside a lowercase e with a round bowl. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
An over-ear headset: a wide arched headband joins two tall rounded-rectangle ear cups at its lower ends.
A heart outline crossed by a horizontal heartbeat line that joins its left and right sides. The line has one tall sharp peak and a smaller dip before reaching the right edge.
A horn drawn as a thick S-shaped tube: a flared rounded bell at the lower left, curving up through a bend to a narrow pointed tip at the upper right. The drawing is abstract and hard to read.
An S-like reversed curve running from the upper left to the lower right, crossed by two parallel horizontal bars through its middle.
A capital H with a middle crossbar beside a smaller lowercase s. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A three-lobed scoop of ice cream sits on a narrow downward-pointing triangular cone. The scoop has a scalloped lower edge where it meets the cone.
A tall capital K with a straight stem and two diagonal arms meeting at its middle. A short horizontal line sits centred beneath the letter.
A narrow upright key with a round bow at the bottom and two teeth near its top stands beside a larger padlock. The padlock has a tall rounded shackle and a small vertical keyhole slot in its body.
A landscape rounded-rectangle input field with two short horizontal dashes and a short vertical cursor bar in a row across its lower middle.
Three diamond-shaped layers stacked vertically. The top layer is a complete diamond outline and the two beneath show only their lower V-shaped edges peeking out below.
A circle containing six straight shutter blades that overlap in a pinwheel, each blade edge running from the rim toward the centre and leaving a hexagonal opening.
An upright rounded-rectangle battery with a small terminal cap on top. A zigzag lightning bolt is marked in the centre of its body.
Two rounded chain links on a diagonal from lower left to upper right. Each link is open where it hooks through the other, so they overlap in the middle.
A teardrop map pin pointing down with a ring at its centre. A short horizontal ground line sits beneath its tip.
A teardrop map pin with a round top narrowing to a point at the bottom. A small ring sits in the round upper part.
A square cabinet split into two tall equal doors by a central vertical divider. Each door has a short vertical handle beside the divider.
A hand truck seen from the side: a tall vertical handle curving back at the top, a round wheel at its base, and a tall rectangular box standing on the platform to its right.
A capital L beside a lowercase u with a rounded bottom and short right stem. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A tall mailbox with a round arched top and straight sides continuing down as two legs. A horizontal slot sits in its upper half and a horizontal line marks the base of the box above the legs.
A teardrop map pin with a small solid dot in its round upper part. Its point continues down into a short vertical stem line.
A capital M with pointed peaks beside a lowercase d with a round bowl and tall stem. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A rounded-rectangle speech bubble with a pointed tail at its lower left. Two equal horizontal text lines sit centred inside.
An oval speech bubble with a short pointed tail at its lower left. Two short vertical eye strokes and a wide U-shaped smile inside turn the bubble into a smiling face.
A rounded square chip body with two short straight pins projecting from each of its four sides, evenly spaced.
A single long horizontal stroke with rounded ends across the middle of the canvas.
A capital M with pointed peaks beside a lowercase n with a single rounded arch. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A round-bellied sack with a flat base, gathered at a narrow neck beneath a flared trapezoid top knot. A large dollar sign is marked on the bag body.
A landscape rectangle banknote with a single large ring centred inside it.
A large crescent moon opening to the right, with a small five-pointed star floating in the space beside its inner curve.
A wide crescent moon opening toward the upper right, with pointed horns at the top and lower right. The outer edge is a full round curve and the inner edge a tighter concave curve.
A wide crescent moon opening toward the upper right, with pointed horns at the top and lower right. The outer edge is a full round curve and the inner edge a tighter concave curve.
Four open chevrons arranged in a diamond around an empty centre, pointing outward up, down, left and right.
A capital N with a diagonal stroke beside a lowercase e with a round bowl. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A bell with a small knob at the top, a rounded dome and flaring sides ending in a straight lip. A short detached clapper dash sits centred beneath the lip.
A capital N with a diagonal stroke beside a lowercase p with a round bowl and descending stem. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
Three separate blades arranged in a trefoil around a small central dot: two at the upper left and upper right and one pointing down. Each blade widens outward with a curved outer edge.
An upright hexagon with rounded corners and a pointed top and bottom, with a round ring hole at its centre.
A tall capital P with a straight stem and a rounded bowl at the top. A short horizontal line sits centred beneath the letter.
A square paint can with a slightly flared lip. Paint spills over the top edge and runs down the front in one long drip and one short drip on the right.
A tapered bucket, wider at the top, with a thick rounded rim. Paint overflows the rim at the upper right and runs down the side in a wavy drip.
A folded paper plane pointing to the upper right. A long triangular wing spans the shape, with a fold line from the tip to its centre and a smaller V-shaped keel folding down beneath.

A flat triangular wing seen from the side, with a rider hanging beneath it: a small round head at the right, a straight body line and a support stroke to the wing. A curved flight line trails below to the left.
A round Ferris-wheel-like disc with a centre dot stands on a trapezoid stand at the left. An arched climbing frame of two tall curved loops rises to its right, joined to the stand by a diagonal line.
A kidney-shaped bean lying on a diagonal from lower left to upper right, with a short curved seam line on its upper inner side.
A slim pen on a diagonal with its pointed nib at the lower left. A cap end at the upper right carries a clip that curves back over the barrel and stops partway down.
A regular five-sided outline with rounded corners, one point at the top and a flat base.
A head-and-shoulders person: a round head floating above a closed torso shape with a domed top and a flat base.
A single continuous outline of a head and shoulders: a tall rounded head narrows into a neck, then slopes out into long shoulders that stop open at the bottom edge.
A head-and-shoulders person outline: a round head whose lower edge overlaps the top of a wide semicircular shoulder arc.
A head-and-shoulders person whose round head carries three short crosshair ticks crossing its outline at the top, left and right. A shoulder arc sits below the head.
A front-facing person: a round head above a torso with rounded shoulders that drop into two arms bent outward at the bottom, leaving the body open below.
A stick figure running to the right with a round head, arms swinging and one leg stretched far back. A small ball with a ring outline sits in front of the forward foot.
A stick figure on the left leans forward with bent knees, one arm pressing straight out against a tall vertical wall line at the right.
A stick figure leaning steeply to the right with a round head, a long straight back leg and a bent front leg. Both arms reach straight ahead as if pushing.
A stick figure seated facing right with a round head, a slanted back, one arm extended forward and legs bent at the knee with the lower leg angled down to the right.
A stick figure falling backward to the left: the body tilts on a diagonal, both arms fly up and out, and the legs splay apart with feet at the lower left.
A telephone handset on a diagonal with rounded earpiece at the upper left and mouthpiece at the lower right. Two concentric curved sound waves radiate to its upper right.
A dome-shaped bell with a flat straight base and a semicircular clapper hanging beneath. Three short rays radiate from above the dome.
A front-view beetle with an oval body and a rounded head section divided by a horizontal line. Two antennae curve up from the head and three bent legs extend from each side.
An outlined airliner seen from above, pointing right: a long rounded fuselage with two large swept wings at its middle and two small tail fins at the left end.
An electric plug with a shield-shaped body, two short straight prongs on top and a short cable stub at the bottom. A lightning bolt is marked in its centre.
A toilet plunger standing upright: a narrow rounded handle grip on a straight shaft, which ends in a wide dome-shaped rubber cup resting on a horizontal base line.
A round-bellied sack with a flat base, gathered at a narrow neck beneath a flared trapezoid top knot. A large heart outline is marked on the bag body.
A pound sterling sign: a tall curved stem hooking over at the top right, crossed by a short horizontal bar at mid-height, and resting on a long flat base stroke.
A nearly complete circle open at the upper left. A short straight arrow with a right-angled head points diagonally out to the upper left from just inside the gap.
A circle open at the top with a vertical line dropping through the gap from above the ring to its centre.
A simple figure with a round head and two short curved pigtails flicking out from either side. Below it a separate tall arch forms the body, opening at the bottom.
A head-and-shoulders person outline: a round head floating above a wide semicircular shoulder arc with a small gap between them.
A trapezoid handbag wider at the base, with a tall semicircular handle on top. A curved flap line runs across the upper part of the bag body.
Two identical opening quotation marks side by side, each a small closed loop at the bottom with a curved tail rising and sweeping to the upper right.
A side-view van with a rounded cab front at the left and two round wheels. A satellite dish on a short mast stands on its roof, tilted up to the upper right.
A puffy cloud with a large central bump and a flat base. Three short parallel rain streaks slant down to the lower left beneath it.
A puffy cloud with a large central bump and a flat base. Three longer rain streaks fall beneath it, leaning slightly to the lower left.
Three concentric semicircular arcs open at the bottom, sharing a baseline. The innermost arc is a small tight hump.
A capital R with a straight diagonal leg beside a lowercase b with a tall stem and round bowl. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
Three bent arrows chase each other around a rounded triangle, each running along one side and turning the corner to point at the next.
A tapered bin wider at the top with a wide flat lid rim and a small raised handle on the lid. A recycle symbol of three chasing arrows is marked on the front of the bin.
A long straight horizontal shaft ending in an open V-shaped arrowhead pointing left.
A capital R with a straight diagonal leg beside a lowercase f with a hooked top and short crossbar. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A scalloped round rosette with wavy edges surrounds a small central ring. Two straight ribbon tails hang beneath, meeting at a centre notch and ending in outer points.
An S-shaped path rises from the bottom left, bends right and turns upward at the top right, ending in an open chevron arrowhead pointing up.
A large round ring band topped by a small faceted gem. The gem is a trapezoid crown with a flat top narrowing to a point where it meets the band.
A bell with a small round knob on top, a rounded dome and straight sides flaring into a flat lip. A short curved clapper arc hangs detached beneath the lip.
A bell with a rounded dome and sides curving outward into a flat lip that flares at both ends. A short straight clapper dash sits detached beneath the lip.
Three equal rings joined by short straight connectors to a shared junction: one ring on the left and two on the right, one above the other.
A capital R with a straight diagonal leg beside a lowercase n with a single rounded arch. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A capital R with a straight diagonal leg beside a lowercase u with a rounded bottom and short right stem. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A single tall capital S drawn as one smooth reversed curve, with open rounded terminals at the upper right and lower left.

A hand saw on a diagonal with the blade at the upper left and the handle at the lower right. The blade has a zigzag toothed lower edge, and a divider line separates it from the rectangular handle with a stepped grip notch.
A capital S beside a lowercase b with a tall stem and round bowl. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A capital S beside a smaller open lowercase c. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A capital S beside a lowercase e with a round bowl. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
The capital letters S and E side by side in even rounded strokes, the E with three horizontal arms of which the middle is slightly shorter.
A side-view bucket seat facing right: a tall backrest leaning back at the left curves smoothly into a long flat seat cushion extending to the right, drawn as one closed rounded outline.
The heavy rounded capitals SELL in one horizontal line. A bold S is followed by an E and two identical Ls.
A capital S beside a lowercase g with a round bowl and hooked descender. A long horizontal line spans beneath both letters.
A curved dorsal fin rises above the water, its front edge sweeping up and back to a pointed tip and its rear edge curving down to the right. A wavy water line runs beneath it.
A shuttlecock on a diagonal with its rounded cork base at the lower left. Its feathered skirt widens toward the upper right into a scalloped cloud-like edge, with two short feather lines inside.
An A-shaped radio mast with a crossbar stands in the centre. Two concentric curved signal waves radiate outward on each side.
A person sitting facing right: a round head above a rounded torso, one forearm resting forward on the lap, and bent legs extending to the left with lower legs dropping down.
A side-view ice skate boot facing right with a tall ankle and sloping toe. Two short posts connect it to a long flat blade beneath that curls up at the front.
A long skateboard deck on a diagonal from lower left to upper right, with both ends kicked up. Two short truck posts hang beneath, each with a small round wheel.
A snowboarder riding down to the left on a long curved board. A round head sits at the right, the body crouches with bent knees, and one arm reaches up behind.
A rounded skull with two round eye dots and a narrower jaw sits above two long straight bones crossing in an X.
The capital letters S and M side by side in even rounded strokes, the M with slightly slanted outer legs and a deep middle V.
A long horizontal cigarette divided into a longer body and a shorter filter section on the right. A wavy smoke trail rises above its left end.
A diving mask with two rounded lenses joined by a nose bridge, and a snorkel tube running up its right side. The tube hooks under the mask at the bottom into a round mouthpiece.
A ski jumper in flight leaning forward: a round head at the top, a bent body line, and a long straight ski running diagonally beneath from lower left to upper right with an upturned tip.

A four-pointed star with long sharp points at the top, bottom, left and right, joined by deeply concave curved sides.
A four-pointed star with concave sides at the left, with two small plus signs to its right: one at the upper right and one lower down.

Three stacked lines of extremely heavy rounded capitals: SPEED, LIMIT and the numeral 20. The strokes are so thick that the letters merge and their counters close up, so the reference is hard to read.
A circular face with a hairline fringe curving across its upper part, dipping to a small peak off centre. Two short slanted eye dashes sit in the lower half, with no mouth.
A fork and a spoon cross in an X. The fork has three tines at the upper left and the spoon an oval bowl at the upper right, with their handles reaching the opposite lower corners.
An upright spoon on the left with a round bowl on a straight handle. An upright knife on the right has a straight spine and a curved blade widening at the top.
A square outline with a small rounded square handle at each of its four corners, like a vector selection box.
Two overlapping equilateral triangles, one pointing up and one pointing down, forming a six-pointed star with a hexagonal centre.
A landscape rounded-rectangle card with a horizontal magnetic stripe line near its top and a short horizontal line at its lower right.
A key on a diagonal: a large round bow at the lower left with a small ring hole, and a straight shaft extending to the upper right, ending in a slanted tip.
A head-and-shoulders person outline: a round head above a shoulder line that rises to a shallow dip at the neck before sloping down to both sides.
A gear with six rounded teeth evenly spaced around its rim and a round ring hole at its centre.
A straight-sided cup with a rounded bottom holding two items that rise above its rim: a pencil tilted slightly left with a pointed triangular tip, and an upright ruler with a narrow open slot.
A curved path starts at a small ring at the lower left and winds up to an arrowhead at the upper right. Two X marks flank the path, one at the upper left and one at the lower right.
The heavy rounded capitals SUB in one horizontal line: an S, a round-bottomed U and a B with two bowls.
A single continuous outline of a head and shoulders: a tall head with slightly wavy sides narrows into a neck, then slopes into long shoulders open at the bottom.
A swing set: a horizontal top beam on two splayed legs. Two vertical ropes hang from the beam, and a curved seat hangs beneath them.
A syringe on a diagonal with the needle at the lower left and a T-shaped plunger handle at the upper right. The rounded barrel carries three short measurement ticks along one side.
A syringe on a diagonal with the needle at the lower left and a T-shaped plunger handle at the upper right. The rounded barrel carries three longer short measurement ticks along one side.
A price tag on a diagonal: a rounded pentagon pointing to the lower left with a small punched hole near its upper right corner.
The heavy rounded capitals TAXI in one horizontal line: a T with a wide top bar, an A with a tiny counter, a crossed X and a serifed I.
Three head-and-shoulders people in a row, the central one lower and in front. The outer figures are partly hidden behind the central figure’s shoulders.
A large open capital C with a small degree ring floating at its upper left.
A rounded square page with three left-aligned horizontal text lines that grow shorter from top to bottom.
An upright rounded document with a folded dog-ear at its upper-right corner. Two equal horizontal text lines sit in its lower middle.

An upright rounded document with a diagonally cut upper-right corner. Two equal horizontal text lines sit across its middle.

An upright thermometer: a narrow rounded tube widening into a round bulb at the bottom, with a long vertical mercury line inside and a dot in the bulb.
Three bowling pins with narrow necks and rounded heads. The larger central pin stands in front, partly hiding the two smaller pins behind it at the left and right.

concept: Three Bowling Pins in a Row
description: Three equal bowling pins stand side by side in a row, their bellies overlapping so that each outline crosses its neighbour.
Three long curved chili peppers stacked horizontally one above another. Each tapers to a point at the left and ends in a short upturned stem at the right.
Three equal circles in a triangular cluster, one on top and two below, each overlapping its neighbours slightly at the centre.
Three small solid dots evenly spaced in a single vertical column with wide gaps between them.
A large heart outline with a small heart outline floating at its upper right. The large heart’s right lobe breaks open where the small heart sits beside it.
A single vertical stem at the bottom splits into three branches ending in rings: one straight up in the centre and two angled out to the upper left and upper right.
A landscape ticket with rounded corners and a semicircular notch cut into the middle of each short side. A single horizontal line sits in its lower right half.
A front-view train: a rounded-rectangle car body split by a horizontal line into a windscreen and lower panel. A short bar sits above the roof and two splayed rail legs extend down from the base.
A tapered bin wider at the top, under a wide flat rim and a dome-shaped lid handle. A single vertical line runs down the centre of the bin body.
A hiker walking to the right with a round head, a tilted rectangular backpack on the back and legs in mid-stride. One arm holds a tall vertical walking pole at the front.
A pointed garden trowel on a diagonal: a triangular blade with rounded corners pointing to the lower left, joined by a short bent neck to a long straight handle reaching the upper right.
Two long curved chili peppers stacked one above the other. Each has a plump body tapering to a point at the left and a short curved stem rising at the right.
Two upright oval eggs sit side by side in a wide shallow bowl-shaped nest. The nest has a flat rim and two short curved strokes marking its woven lower body.
Two simple standing people face each other, each with a round head and an arm curving inward. Between them their arms form a heart split down the middle by a jagged crack.
Two simple standing people face each other with round heads. Their inward-reaching arms join to form one heart shape between them.
Two head-and-shoulders people: a larger figure at the right in front and a smaller figure at the left behind it, with its shoulder arc partly hidden.
A round tablet with a horizontal score line at the upper left and a diagonal two-part capsule at the lower right, divided across its middle.
A vertical arrow pointing up grows from a small ring at its base. Two parallel horizontal lines lie beneath the ring.
Two head-and-shoulders people side by side, the left one slightly larger and in front. Each has a round head above a closed rounded torso with a flat base.
A straight diagonal stem runs from the lower left to the upper right. Two pairs of short straight side branches meet it at right angles, forming arrowhead-like forks along the upper half.
A side-view video camera: a rounded rectangle body facing right with a trapezoid lens shape flaring out from its right side.

A large circle with a small dot at its centre and ten short straight spikes radiating evenly from its rim. The spiky round form can also read as a sun.
A landscape rounded-rectangle box with a detached inverted trapezoid, wider at the top, floating above its centre like a folded ballot entering the box. The drawing is abstract and hard to read.
A tall capital W with pointed inner peak and outer strokes slightly splayed. A short horizontal line sits centred beneath the letter.

A rectangular back panel open along its lower right edge, with a slanted front flap folded diagonally across its left side like an open wallet or folder cover. The drawing is abstract and hard to read.
A landscape rounded wallet with a horizontal fold line across its upper part. A rounded clasp tab protrudes from its right edge with a small oval snap button.

An abstract angular jet ski tilted down to the lower left, with a bent V-shaped handlebar at its top. Two parallel speed lines trail beneath on the left and a wavy water line runs to the right. The drawing is hard to read.
A horizontal heartbeat line: flat at both ends, with a small bump, a dip, one tall sharp peak and a deep trough in the middle.
A seated figure facing right with a round head, an arm reaching forward, and a leg bent down to the lower right. A large open arc beneath the body forms the wheelchair wheel.
Two horizontal lines of different lengths, one above the other. The upper line curls up into a hook at its right end, and the lower line curls down into a hook.
A front-facing woman: long hair falls in a tall arch around both sides of an open shield-shaped face that has a pointed central parting at the top.
A head-and-shoulders silhouette with a centre-parted hairline at the top. Hair arches around the head and flicks outward at shoulder level on both sides, above sloped shoulders.
